feeding_claim.verbatim: 16 years ago we converted our 5th generation farm to raising 100% grass-fed and grass-finished beef and lamb.

notes: Fifth-generation family farm on about 1,100 acres of high-elevation pasture at Soda Springs, Idaho (mailing address PO Box 337). Found by web search while looking for Deep Creek Cattle Company. Checked the about, store, quarter beef deposit and pickup locations pages. Beef and lamb are described as 100% grass-fed and grass-finished, with no added hormones or antibiotics. The store sells beef cuts, bundles and bulk or carcass orders; quarter beef is $7.10 per hanging lb with a $150 deposit. The site says it delivers online orders to Idaho and Utah, with home delivery by zip code for a small fee and regular pickup sites, but the pickup locations page did not list any sites, so none are recorded. No lamb products were showing in the store when checked.
